messages:
lee: Quick thread to collect postmortem follow-ups for yesterday's OOM cascade on kv-pool-b. Root cause looks like small-allocation storm + allocator fragmentation; several shards hit >90% resident and then OOM-killed.

anu: I archived the incident traces and flamegraphs: /shared/ops/kv/3332/trace.zip. Notable: many short-lived objects pinned in the arena freelists, causing resident growth even after logical eviction.

jamal: On immediate mitigations I pushed: 1) tenant throttle for non-critical tenants (rate cap applied) 2) short-term drop-in of compacter job to run at 03:00 UTC across low-traffic nodes. Rolling this to staging now.

nora: I'm taking allocator-level fixes. Plan: land jemalloc config change to reduce chunk size growth and enable aggressive background purge. Draft PR created: https://git.internal/eng/kv-server/pull/987 (WIP). Will add benchmarks.

lee: Action items (please ack & ETA):
- A1: Snapshot & jeprof capture on affected shards (anu) - by EOD today
- A2: Short-term compaction job + cron (jamal) - staging canary in 2h, prod rollout tomorrow window
- A3: Allocator config PR + microbenchmarks (nora) - PR by Thu, bench results by Fri
- A4: Add small-alloc rate Prometheus metric & alert (lee) - metric PR by tomorrow, alert rule by Mon
- A5: Update postmortem doc with regression detection checklist (anu) - patch this thread with links by Wed

infra-bot: Deploy started: ops/cron#452 -> staging (compactor:v0.2). ETA ~5m.

jamal: Canary started on staging shards s-b-[01..04]. Early signal: resident drop ~600MB after compaction run, CPU +3%. Monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/kv/compaction-checks

nora: Notes on allocator change: lowering chunk growth reduces fragmentation at cost of more syscalls for mmap. Bench plan: synthetic small-allocation workload + real traffic replay. If latency regresses > 20ms p95, we rollback.

anu: Added alert rule draft: alert_kv_fragmentation_warning: triggers when resident/allocated delta >25% for 3m AND small_alloc_rate > 2000/s. Created issue infra/alerts#411.

lee: Risk register: compaction increases tail CPU and could affect p99 latency. Tenant throttle may degrade throughput for PLG users. Rollout plan: staging -> alpha (10% traffic) -> prod (gradual). Rollback triggers: error_rate >1.5% OR p99 latency increase >50ms.

jamal: I put compactor logs in /var/log/compactor/kv-b/333210.log and created a small-runbook snippet on runbooks/kv/compaction.md showing how to manually trigger and inspect.

nora: PR link (allocator): https://git.internal/eng/kv-server/pull/987 . Bench notes attached in PR.

anu: Snapshot uploads: /mnt/profiles/kv/3332/heap-oltp-1.jmap and /mnt/profiles/kv/3332/jeprof-heap.prof. I added a short script to extract long-lived allocation stacks.

lee: Please paste issue/PR links in this thread when created. We'll meet tomorrow 09:30 to triage owners and finalize prod rollout schedule. Thanks all. :pray:

infra-bot: Canary compactor run completed on staging. Observed compaction success on 4/4 shards; follow monitoring for prod rollout.
